model.notes: Frozen FLUX.2 klein 9B base backbone (gated, non-commercial licence). LoRA-trained on 1,000 accepted pairs from Policy-Evolving Edit Synthesis. Baseline is the untrained backbone under the same judge.

metrics.evaluation_scope: primary_score is 0.5 * (gedit_bench / 10 + imgedit_bench / 5). Raw judge means are reported on native scales (GEdit-Bench 0-10, ImgEdit-Bench 0-5). In-loop acceptance and destination entropy are synthesis diagnostics and are not the headline metric.

stratified_pipeline.note: Same 1,000-pair budget and LoRA recipe, without policy evolution.

in_loop_synthesis.note: Shared across backbones: 1,000 accepted pairs, 23 edit types. Acceptance uses the frozen if_vc_vq rubric, not GEdit/ImgEdit.

destination_entropy.note: Normalised Shannon entropy, mean excluding H3 and O9 as in the method README.

settings.seed_note: Per-run seeds were not recorded in the upstream pull request.
settings.compute_budget: Reference environment: 8x H20 in docker/generative-image-edit. One LoRA run per arm on 1,000 accepted pairs. Inner synthesis uses a fixed batch budget of ten scenes per batch per edit type. FLUX.2-klein-base-9B is gated; accept the Hub licence before download.

reproducibility.command: construct harness.AgenticLoop from a CampaignSpec with setting_id 'policy-evolving', then LoRA-train black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-base-9B on the 1,000 accepted pairs and score GEdit-Bench and ImgEdit-Bench in docker/generative-image-edit

evaluation_harness.name: VLM judge (GEdit VIEScore overall, ImgEdit Bench judge)
evaluation_harness.note: The judge is a hosted VLM and is not vendored. Offline verification re-aggregates saved per-sample scores with benchmarks/image-edit-transfer-suite/evaluator.py.
